---
title: "M25 · Reinforcement Learning"
subtitle: "Deep Learning & Modalities · 0 of 9 lessons ready"
---

**Prerequisites:** [M20 Deep Learning Foundations](m20.qmd) · **GPU:** optional

| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :-: | :--- |
| 01 | Reinforcement Learning Fundamentals & MDPs (Gymnasium) | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Agent, environment, reward, states, actions, and Markov decision processes. |
| 02 | Value-Based Methods (Deep Q-Networks - Stable-Baselines3) | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Q-learning, SARSA, and value approximation with deep Q-networks. |
| 03 | Policy Gradient Methods (PPO - Stable-Baselines3) | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | REINFORCE, actor-critic, and proximal policy optimization. |
| 04 | Exploration Strategies & Multi-Armed Bandits | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Epsilon-greedy, entropy, and exploration/exploitation balance. |
| 05 | Deep RL at Scale (Ray RLlib) | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Distributed deep reinforcement learning training and scaling strategies. |
| 06 | Safe & Constrained RL | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Constraints, risk-aware policies, and deployment safeguards. |
| 07 | Sim-to-Real & Embedded RL Deployment | 🔴 Expert | 🛠️ in progress | Transferring trained policies from simulation to constrained edge hardware. |
| 08 | Offline Reinforcement Learning |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 09 | Reinforcement Learning for LLMs (RLHF, GRPO, RLVR) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
